defects.title: A message sent while the conversation is scrolled up is not brought into view
defects.repro: Continue as a person with a valid token, send about 8 messages so the Conversation scrolls, scroll the Conversation to the top, then type a message in Message and press Enter.
defects.observed: The new person message and its reply are added below the visible area (reading scrollTop stays 0; last article at y=2156 in an 812-pixel window, the same at 1440x900); nothing indicates that the reply arrived.
defects.expected: Sending a message shows the sent message and its reply (or at least indicates a new reply below), so the conversation being written stays in view.
